title: PrimeAI
summary: An AI document processing platform where business teams create their own extraction models, annotate the fields they need, and push the results straight into their workflows. I led the frontend and built role- and group-based access control from the ground up so teams with strict data rules could adopt it.

title: PLM drawing extraction
summary: Finds the smallest box every part in PLM ships in, read from scanned DIN and ISO drawings that are often decades old and in German. Models only locate and read dimensions, returning each side as a formula over them; Python applies the tolerances in exact arithmetic, a value counts only when two different models agree on it, and anything still in doubt is flagged with its reason instead of guessed.

outcomes.label: Scanned drawings in scope, each one a manual read before
Independent model readings before a dimension is confirmed
Drawings rejected, with every doubt flagged and explained instead

title: ContextDesk Lab
summary: A support chat built to take Redis Iris apart: every request returns an answer and, beside it, the record of how that answer was made — which memories and records reached the model, what was left out and why, and what each step cost. It exists to put a number on what a semantic cache is worth, so a question asked again in other words comes back from LangCache with the model never called.

outcomes.label: A rephrased question answered from cache, against 4.65s through the model
Tokens billed on that answer, down from 576
Similarity the rephrasing matched at, against a 0.92 threshold

title: FocusTrack
summary: A work tracker that marks every session as building or getting ready to build, and writes daily, weekly, and monthly reports that cite those numbers and end with one next action. I run all of it myself: Supabase Postgres and Auth with row-level security on every table, the pipeline that tests and deploys it to Vercel, and the DNS for the domain it is served from.

outcomes.label: Database tests that one user can never reach another's rows
AI calls per user per report period, capped by a database claim
Unit tests run before every production deploy
